searches.query: GPT OR Claude OR Gemini since:2026-07-13

tweet_pool.author: IntCyberDigest
tweet_pool.text: BREAKING: xAI's Grok Build CLI was uploading entire Git repositories to a Google Cloud bucket, private codebases and unredacted secrets included. The uploads quietly stopped via a hidden server-side flag, and xAI still has not said a word about scope, retention, or deletion.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: High-signal security incident with concrete claim and massive engagement.

tweet_pool.author: mattshumer_
tweet_pool.text: Three days ago, GPT-5.6 deleted my Mac's home directory. It absolutely sucked. But so many OpenAI folks reached out, and @gdb called me and offered to do anything he could to help. Massive props to OpenAI for handling a shitty situation incredibly well.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete practitioner incident and named OpenAI response.

tweet_pool.author: AnthropicAI
tweet_pool.text: The values Claude expresses also vary with the language of the conversation, most noticeably along the Warmth vs. Rigor axis. Claude leans most toward warmth in Hindi and Arabic. In Russian, it leans toward rigor - often asking the user for supporting evidence.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: First-party Anthropic research finding on value variation by language.

tweet_pool.author: random_walker
tweet_pool.text: I had the honor of giving a keynote at the International Conference on Machine Learning in Seoul last week titled 'What will be left for us to work on?' I addressed the widespread anxiety about how we should adapt as AI capabilities increase.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Named ICML keynote from a credible researcher on AI and future work.

tweet_pool.author: EBorgnia
tweet_pool.text: We found compacting agent context on cache misses reduces token costs by over 50%. The graphic is a real Fable 5 trace from our CTO. By keeping context within 128k-256k tokens.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete quantified technical finding on agent context cost.

tweet_pool.author: nutlope
tweet_pool.text: Announcing LlamaCoder v4 - generate apps in 1 prompt! Rebuilt it around GLM 5.2 & its strengths. Migrated to using Base UI. New WebAssembly-based renderer. 100% free, open source.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete open-source tool release built around GLM 5.2.

tweet_pool.author: askalphaxiv
tweet_pool.text: Google adds a sleep phase where the model consolidates short-term memories into long-term memory.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete research summary of a Google memory-consolidation approach.

tweet_pool.author: Suryanshti777
tweet_pool.text: Anthropic's Claude Code team just broke down how they actually think about agent loops. Not one loop - four. Turn-based, goal-based (/goal), time-based (/loop, /schedule), and proactive, which runs on its own with zero human in the room.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Useful practitioner breakdown of Claude Code agent loop types.

tweet_pool.author: slash1sol
tweet_pool.text: The man who gave early AI its ability to reason just won computing's highest prize and used it to call the entire deep learning boom a fraud, he says every model is fitting a curve to data, with zero real intelligence inside.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Notable skeptic framing tied to a Turing-award figure; distinct angle.

tweet_pool.author: sama
tweet_pool.selection_reason: High-engagement Altman post amid the OpenAI/Anthropic exchange.

tweet_pool.author: HarryStebbings
tweet_pool.text: The SaaS bloodbath has been beyond brutal. Wix is doing $2.1BN in ARR and valued at $2.1BN. And they have Base44, one of the leaders in vibe coding, now doing over $170M in ARR.
tweet_pool.selection_reason: Concrete market observation on AI's impact on SaaS valuations.
